name: Iron Front
art_style: gritty realistic military illustration, weathered metal textures, muted battlefield lighting
master_prompt: A war-torn frontier where an elite mechanized battalion holds the last supply line against an overwhelming enemy advance
master_prompt_enhanced: The ravaged frontier landscape stretches out in a barren expanse of dusty trenches, cratered roads, and shattered tree stumps, as the mechanized battalion's armored behemoths stand sentinel over the last vital supply line, a lifeline of weathered fuel drums, sandbagged bunkers, and tangled concertina wire. The enemy's relentless advance has scorched the earth, leaving behind a trail of smoldering wreckage and rusting hulks, their twisted metal carcasses a testament to the battalion's desperate defense. Under the sickly glow of dusk, the olive drab and gunmetal grey of the battalion's machinery seems to blend seamlessly into the surrounding terrain, as if the very earth itself has been forged into a formidable bulwark against the oncoming tide of war. Amidst the eerie stillness, the distant rumble of artillery and the acrid tang of smoke hang in the air, a constant reminder of the enemy's looming presence.
